title: Utopia region renamed Galaxias Chaos after the second face

tellings.quote: And then they changed the name of the region from being just Utopia to Galaxis Chaos.

plain: A region of Mars once called simply Utopia was renamed Galaxias Chaos in the 1980s, after a second face-like formation was noticed there, according to John Brandenburg. Brandenburg is a physicist who argues that life on Mars was wiped out by nuclear war. He tells Michels this from his own involvement and presents the renaming as a sign that the face drew official attention.
